lesson.title: Understanding Opa Distance

sections.title: What is an Opa Unit?
sections.content: Based on the provided text, one 'opa unit' is a measurement of distance. One opa unit is equal to four metres (Section 1).

sections.title: Calculating Distance
sections.content:
To find the total distance across nine units, you multiply the number of units by the length of one unit.

Calculation:
9 units × 4 metres per unit = 36 metres.

The source confirms that nine units measure thirty-six metres (Section 1).

lesson.title: Understanding One Third

sections.title: What is a Third?
sections.content: One third is one of three equal parts of a whole group. To be 'equal' means that each part has the same number.

sections.title: Example: Sharing Apples
sections.content: If there are twelve apples and three people share them equally, each person gets four apples. In this case, four apples is one third of the twelve apples because it is one of three equal parts.

lesson.summary: One third means dividing a whole group into three equal parts. Each part contains the same amount.
objectives: Explain one third in simple words
lesson.content:
One third is one of three equal parts of a whole group. To be 'equal' means that each part has the same number.

If there are twelve apples and three people share them equally, each person gets four apples. In this case, four apples is one third of the twelve apples because it is one of three equal parts.

If there are twelve apples and three people share them equally, each person gets four apples. In this case, four apples is one third of the twelve apples because it is one of three equal parts.

[section:1]
Three people share twelve apples equally. Each receives four apples. One third is one of three equal parts of the whole group. Equal means the same number here.

exercises.question: If there are four rema bags and each bag has nine tokens inside, how many tokens are there in total?
exercises.explanation: To find the total, you multiply the number of bags (4) by the number of tokens in each bag (9). 4 times 9 equals 36. (Source: SLM_SOURCE_0 [segment:1])
hints: Think about how many tokens are in just one bag.
If you have four bags, you need to add the number of tokens together four times.
You can multiply 4 by 9 to get the final answer.

source_usage.fragment:

[section:1]
Four rema bags each contain nine tokens.

exercises.question: How many total kopi cubes are there in all seven packs?
exercises.explanation: According to the source data, there are seven packs and each pack holds three cubes. To find the total, you multiply 7 (packs) by 3 (cubes per pack), which equals 21.
hints: Think about how many cubes are in just one pack.
If one pack has 3 cubes, how many would be in two packs?
You need to find the total for all seven packs.

questions.question_text: In the story about five people and twenty disks, why is the sharing called 'equal'?
questions.explanation: The text states that equal sharing means everyone receives the same number. In this case, each person gets four disks [segment:1].
